parent.original_P25R2_head_limited: GRU yhat = Linear([h,a]) implies action contrast 2*W_action independent of h; impossible history-conditioned effect

hypothesis: Given real matched action interventions from physical source conditions that differ in previously unseen pole lengths, an interaction-capable recurrent model can learn how action consequences vary with past observed continuous state and recent factual actions, and beat a train-fitted constant-action-effect and context-misaligned same-model controls on heldout real physical histories.
null: If heldout factual action-effect heterogeneity is below predeclared floor, the source conditions do not test the mechanism; if it exists but recurrent interaction fails heldout improvements, mechanism unsupported. Never conflate failures with source/infrastructure errors.

source.original_environment_parameters_only: per instance length and polemass_length=masspole*length before reset, physical source code unchanged

physical_protocol.observer: Last 8 factual rows of [public cart position, 0 masked cart velocity, public pole angle, 0 masked angular velocity, previous ACTUALLY EXECUTED action +/-1, previously OBSERVED reward]; source length never provided to the learner
physical_protocol.prefix_actions: independent seeded balanced 0/1 pairs; replay same exact executed actions in both original source instances; no expert or hidden source labels
physical_protocol.intervention: Sister worlds identical real reset and prefix; actually execute opposite source actions 0 and 1 for one step; subsequently ACTUALLY EXECUTE seven predeclared identical actions [0,1,1,0,0,1,1] on both actual source instances, observing all consequences. No simulator-generated unexecuted counterfactuals.
physical_protocol.effect_target: Two-component [cart position delta, 10* pole angle delta] after same 8-step action horizon; effect = observed branch1 minus observed branch0; discard paired comparison with logged reason if either source branch terminates or truncates before completing horizon. Record and include both trajectory hashes. Never impute nonexecuted outcomes.

models.architecture: Gated recurrent 6->9 history hidden; contextual effect head e(h) and state head m(h): yhat=m(h)+a*e(h) with action-coded -1/+1. No tokenizer/transformer.
models.optimizer: AdamW exact source CPU torch pinned
models.sham_training: same action labels and factual targets but permute full historical x independently from y within each training epoch, with model-seed-controlled random permutation; preserves marginal observation history and raw effect labels but destroys contextual association. Test true matched history.
models.additive: same recurrent state predictor but action-effect head e(h) evaluated at zero hidden, so effect cannot vary with h. Keep module/optimizer shape; report effective active parameter count and identical update budget.
models.conventional_mlp: History-flat MLP mean+action*effect head; trained for exactly equal epochs, examples, batches. Report parameters and compute.
models.conventional_ridge: Factual train-fitted history + actual action + interaction with historical public position/angle finite differences and previous executed action. Ridge regularization fixed 1e-5, no heldout tuning.

predeclared_metrics.effect_MSE: Mean over all heldout actual source sister pairs and both target coordinates of (predicted_effect - factual_effect)^2.
predeclared_metrics.constant_effect: Mean factual action effect on TRAIN source pairs, then predict same effect on all heldout histories; no evaluation calibration.
predeclared_metrics.effect_context_variance: Mean heldout squared deviation of factual effect from train fitted constant effect. Require >= 0.0001 on EACH heldout length; otherwise do not claim state-dependent mechanism tested.
predeclared_metrics.effect_skill_vs_constant: 1 - GRU_effect_MSE / train_fitted_constant_effect_MSE. This is not centered statistical R2.
predeclared_metrics.strongest_conventional_architecture_supe: Across all three seeds, MSE <=0.9*lowest(MSE trained MLP, trained ridge) on BOTH heldout lengths with matched whole-process compute; otherwise not demonstrated.
